description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_URISchemeRegistry class, which manages registration and retrieval of URI scheme validator objects for the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URISchemeRegistry
classes.description: Registry class for URI scheme validators, allowing registration and retrieval of specific scheme objects.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the registry, optionally resetting or replacing it with a prototype.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the validator object for a given URI scheme if allowed and exists.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a custom URI scheme validator object directly into the registry.
